about.title: About GOSTA TRANS
about.presentation: GOSTA TRANS LOGISTICS & BTP is a Central African company based in Bangui, at PK14 Boali Road. It brings together under one structure materials transport, equipment rental with operator and construction works — from structural to finishing works.
about.methode: Every request follows the same thread: receiving the need, mobilising resources (trucks, equipment, teams), then supervised execution on site. This continuity between logistics and construction limits delays caused by supply breaks.
about.engagement: The team works on individual houses as well as residential, commercial or industrial buildings, and on roadworks and urban sanitation projects — with the reliability of a single point of contact from start to finish.

comments.quote: Materials delivery and coffered ceiling installation handled by the same team, without having to coordinate several providers.
The team mobilises equipment quickly when an unexpected issue delays the schedule — that's what you expect from a logistics partner.
A single point of contact from materials transport to roadworks, which greatly simplifies site monitoring.
